messages:
Priya: FYI Beacon Health (acct BH-889) flagged INV-2026-0098 for $47,298.57 — they asked for an installment plan and opened a dispute for 12/14 usage. Dropping context below.

Carlos: I reached out by phone this morning. They want a 3-month split, said they can do 30% upfront. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

Jordan: Dispute ticket #2389 is open. Customer claims duplicate training job charges on 12/14 — I see 2 jobs, one looks like an internal dev run. I can flag the suspect lines pending audit.

Avery: I'm okay with 3-months if they pay 30% today and sign a payment plan + dispute waiver. We should require a signed agreement to avoid churn.

Priya: They sent PO-993 and updated billing email to billing@beaconhealth.org. Payment method = ACH (we have a prior R01 — small risk). Carlos, can you confirm collections cadence?

collections-bot: Reminder scheduled: automated dunning email will be sent at 1765640000 if no signed plan or payment received.

Elena (Support): Customer forwarded the job logs and account admin changed to lisa@beaconhealth.org — shared S3 export in the ticket. They insist the duplicate is our ingestion metric.

Carlos: Proposed plan (draft sent to legal):
```
Terms: 3 payments over 60 days. 30% upfront, 35% day 30, 35% day 60. Disputed charge capped at $4,200 and held until audit completes. No product suspension while on plan.
```
Sending DocuSign link now.

Avery: Add a clause: if audit finds charges valid, remaining balance becomes due immediately. If audit clears, issue credit within 5 business days. Approve sending with that clause. :thumbsup:

Priya: Sent DocuSign + Stripe invoice link to billing@beaconhealth.org. Marking AR note: BH-889-PTL. Please update ledger when first payment posts.

Jordan: Quick audit update: job_id 8861 flagged as internal dev, looks like erroneous run — I will reclassify and push a credit request for ~$3,900 if confirmed.

Carlos: Will follow up tomorrow AM. If first payment posts, we pause escalation and close the dispute hold path. Otherwise, escalate to collections manager by EOD+3.

Priya: Noted. Keeping thread for docs. Thanks everyone.
